thesis: Krishna Rao argues that compute is the lifeblood of Anthropic and the most consequential decision in the company, requiring a disciplined approach to procurement that balances the risk of buying too much against the inability to serve customers if buying too little. He explains that Anthropic achieves efficiency by using three different chip platforms (Amazon's training chips, Google TPUs, and Nvidia GPUs) fungibly across model development, internal use, and customer demand, supported by an orchestration layer that allows them to utilize each chip for its best purpose.
